about: ROUTE R3, THE PILGRIM WAY (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from the Colosseum's ground (south, rows -9; the Colosseum, built by phase 4.4 in the Vatican's room; that end's door is `ow_h_m10_m9` on the Colosseum's north wall) north up to Mount Olympus, which it reaches on the Pilgrim Stair's east side (seam ow_v_m10_m13). ONE room, 10 plots (3 x 4). PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the page gives shrines on the way; the rest are the kit's picks by the ground.
